Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.1044, 0.2242, 0.195163, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "04:01", "label_box": [ 0.09640000000000001, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "question", "box": [ 0.4102478333333333, 0.22419999999999998, 0.11093333333333336, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "amber", "focus": true, "label": "4H 29M", "label_box": [ 0.360133, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.631867, 0.2242, 0.195163, 0.256 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "08:30", "label_box": [ 0.623867, 0.4862, 0.211163, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** The two markers held level against a dusty-amber gutter, neither above the other. Beneath them, one line of ledger: `4H 29M UNRECONCILED`. A third, tempting marker labelled `THE FIRST RCE` hovers between them and is struck out.

**Action:** The book declines to pick.

**Caption:**
> THE VICTIM'S RECORD REACHES FURTHER BACK THAN THE LABORATORY'S.

**Provenance:** `disputed` — no public audit reconciles the two accounts. Bounded to this pair of timestamps: `HF-TL` recovers 04:01, `OAI-TR` §X records 08:30.

", "title": "The timing discrepancy stays unreconciled" } }
